text.c02: [happy] Hi everyone, sorry to keep you waiting~!
text.c04: [happy] Ehehe, I'm so happy. Today is a special fan meeting just for you!
text.c07: [playful] And hello from this side too~!
text.c08: [shy] Hey hey… I'll tell you a secret. Just you.
text.c09: [whispers] Actually… I was super nervous about today's stage.
text.c10: [whispers] [shy] But when I saw your face… I forgot all about it.
text.c12: [happy] So today, I'll sing just for you!
text.c15: [cheerful] Phew… the stage lights are kinda hot.
text.c16: [happy] I know! Let me fan you!
text.c21: [happy] And then… ta-da! An ice-cold drink!
text.c23: [cheerful] Here you go. …Hear that clink? Nice, right?
text.c24: [happy] Next… a game! Guess which side I'll talk from!
text.c28: [playful] Oh, that breeze just now… secret magic!
text.c39: [happy] Did you get them all? You're amazing!
text.c40: [happy] And now… a mini live, just for you!
text.c49: [whispers] Thank you so much… for coming today.
